name: skill-smith
purpose: Guides an agent through building a new skill that passes the factory linter, evals and review.

name: figure-craft
purpose: Draws any object the user describes as a full, lit isometric figure the reader can open, turn and hover, checked by lint L1 to L19.

name: changelog-writer
purpose: Turns merged changes into a CHANGELOG entry with the correct semver bump.

name: copy-tight
purpose: Rewrites UI copy to be short and plain without changing meaning, numbers, names or legal text.

name: test-planner
purpose: Derives a numbered regression checklist, grouped by area, from a change description or diff; never adds features the change does not name.

name: ui-polish
purpose: Runs a final polish pass on finished UI code: on-scale spacing and type, readable contrast, one primary action and visible states; keeps every word and the brand hue.

name: design-system
purpose: Builds one complete design-token set (W3C JSON and CSS, light and dark, every contrast ratio checked) from a hex, a style or the project's existing tokens; keeps the user's hue and never overwrites existing tokens.

name: spec-writer
purpose: Writes testable acceptance criteria as numbered Given-When-Then clauses from a feature request, user story or requirement; what the text does not state becomes open questions, never invented clauses.

name: a11y-audit
purpose: Audits pasted HTML or JSX for what users cannot see (names, labels, keyboard access, ARIA, status messages, language, tables, media, zoom) and lists numbered findings with element, rule id, WCAG 2.2 criterion, who is affected and the exact fix; never contrast, focus style, spacing, target size, flow or visible text.
